name: close_doc
title: Close Document
description: Close the current Rhino document. If path is given, save to that .3dm path first; otherwise discard unsaved changes.

path.description: Optional absolute .3dm path to save to before closing. Omit to close without saving.

name: get_commands
title: List Rhino Commands
description: Discover Rhino command names available to run_command. Returns English names from all registered plugins (including those not yet loaded; invoking such a command may trigger plugin load). Test commands are excluded. Use filter to narrow the list before calling run_command.

filter.description: Substring filter (case-insensitive). Strongly recommended — unfiltered results can exceed 1000 commands.

name: get_selection
title: Get Selection
description: Return all currently selected objects in Rhino.

name: get_viewport_image
title: Capture Viewport Image
description: Capture the active Rhino viewport as JPG. Returns the image plus a JSON metadata block describing the resulting camera, display mode, framed scene bounds, and on-screen object count — use the metadata to diagnose empty/off-screen captures without re-shooting.

view.description: Standard view: top, bottom, left, right, front, back, perspective

displayMode.description: Display mode by English name: Wireframe, Shaded, Rendered, Ghosted, X-Ray, Technical, Artistic, Pen, Monochrome, Arctic, Raytraced

boxMin.description: Frame this bounding box (min corner). Pair with boxMax. Replaces zoom — agent supplies what to frame, tool computes how far back to stand.

boxMax.description: Frame this bounding box (max corner). Pair with boxMin.

zoom.description: Magnification factor: >1 zoom in, 0<x<1 zoom out. Applied after boxMin/boxMax if both supplied.

name: g1_apply_graph
title: Apply GH1 Graph
description: Place sliders + components and wire them in one call. References between objects use caller-supplied 'key' strings; the tool returns the key→Guid map. Failures in any step do not abort the rest; results report per-step status. Wire src/dst use the same selector semantics as 'g1_connect'.

sliders.description: Sliders to place: {Key, Min, Value, Max, Type, Name?, X, Y}. Type ∈ 'float'|'int'|'even'|'odd'.

components.description: Components to place: {Key, Selector, X, Y}. Selector is a Guid (preferred — avoids name ambiguity) or component Name.

wires.description: Wires to create: {SrcKey, Src, DstKey, Dst}. Keys must match a slider or component key above.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution at the end.

name: g1_clear_canvas
title: Clear GH1 Canvas
description: Remove every object from the active GH1 canvas. Destructive — requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually wipe the canvas. Defaults to false as a safety guard.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after clearing. Set false to batch multiple operations and solve once at the end.

name: g1_connect_many
title: Connect GH1 Wires (Batch)
description: Wire multiple output→input connections in one call. Same selector semantics as 'g1_connect' (numeric index or Name/NickName; '' or '0' for pure params). A failed wire does not stop later ones; per-wire results are returned. solve runs once at the end.

wires.description: Array of {SrcId, Src, DstId, Dst} wire descriptors.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after wiring. Set false to batch further.

name: g1_connect
title: Connect GH1 Wire
description: Wire an output parameter to an input parameter on the active GH1 canvas. 'src' and 'dst' may be a numeric index or a Name/NickName. For pure params (e.g. a slider) pass '' or '0'.

src.description: Output identifier: numeric index, output Name, or output NickName. Use '' or '0' for pure params.

dst.description: Input identifier: numeric index, input Name, or input NickName. Use '' or '0' for pure params.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after wiring. Set false to batch multiple operations and solve once at the end.

name: g1_describe_component
title: Describe GH1 Component
description: Look up a Grasshopper component by name and return its category, description, and input/output parameter list. Useful before placing or wiring components.

name.description: Component name as it appears in the component library (e.g. 'Number Slider', 'Addition'). Case-insensitive.

name: g1_get_canvas_graph
title: Get GH1 Canvas Graph
description: Return a structured snapshot of the active GH1 canvas: objects (with messages, inputs/outputs and optional volatile data summaries) and wires between them.

sample_size.description: How many items to include in each data sample.

name: g1_place_component
title: Place GH1 Component
description: Place a Grasshopper component onto the active GH1 canvas. 'selector' may be a Guid (proxy id) or a component name. If multiple components share the name, returns an ambiguity payload listing candidates.

selector.description: Component Guid (proxy id) or component Name (case-insensitive).

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after placing. Set false to batch multiple operations and solve once at the end.

name: g1_place_slider
title: Place GH1 Number Slider
description: Place a Number Slider on the active GH1 canvas with the given range and current value. type: 'float' | 'int' | 'even' | 'odd'.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after placing. Set false to batch multiple operations and solve once at the end.

name: g1_search_components
title: Search GH1 Components
description: Search the Grasshopper component library by substring. Matches Name, NickName, and Description (case-insensitive). Optional exact-match category/subcategory filters. Returns up to 'limit' matches.

query.description: Substring to match against component Name, NickName, and Description. Case-insensitive.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

name: g1_solve_graph
title: Solve GH1 Graph
description: Solves the active GH canvas. zoom_views controls whether Rhino viewports zoom to the new preview: true=always, false=never, null=auto (zoom only when nothing was previewed before the solve).

zoom_views.description: Auto-zoom every Rhino viewport to the GH preview after solving. true=always, false=never, null=zoom only when nothing was visible pre-solve.

name: g1_start
title: Start Grasshopper 1
description: Starts Grasshopper

name: list_objects
title: List Document Objects
description: List objects in the active document. Filter by name, layer, or geometry type. Pure query — does not change selection or viewport.

geometryType.description: Filter by type: point, pointset, curve, surface, brep, mesh, annotation, light, block

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (default 1000)

name: open_doc
title: Open / Import Document
description: Import a .3dm (or other supported) file into the current document. Headless — no dialogs. Optionally clear the document first to make this behave like an open-in-place.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to import

clearFirst.description: If true, delete all objects in the current document before importing

name: run_command
title: Run Rhino Command
description: Execute any Rhino command string and return command window output. Example: "_Box 0,0,0 10,10,10"

name: run_csharp
title: Run C# Script
description: Execute a C# script targeted at this slot's document. The script editor injects `__rhino_doc__` (type `RhinoDoc`) — use it as your document handle instead of `RhinoDoc.ActiveDoc` or anything else. Returns JSON with stdout and error fields; error is null on success.

name: run_python
title: Run Python Script
description: Execute a Python 3 script targeted at this slot's document. The script editor injects `__rhino_doc__` — use it as your document handle. Do NOT trust `scriptcontext.doc` or `rhinoscriptsyntax` calls. Returns JSON with stdout and error fields; error is null on success.

name: save_doc
title: Save Document
description: Write the current document to the given .3dm path. Headless — no dialogs. Overwrites any existing file at the path.

path.description: Absolute path to write the .3dm file to

name: set_camera
title: Set Camera
description: Set the active viewport camera. Any subset of position, target, up vector, lens length, projection, or framing bounding-box may be supplied.

boxMin.description: Frame this bounding box (min corner). Pair with boxMax. Applied last so it dominates location/target if both supplied.

boxMax.description: Frame this bounding box (max corner). Pair with boxMin.

name: set_layer_material
title: Set Layer Material
description: Set the render material on a layer. Accepts diffuse color, transparency, and gloss. Optionally also sets the layer display color.

color.description: Diffuse color hex like '#FF0000' or known color name

applyToLayerColor.description: Also apply color as the layer display (wireframe) color

name: set_selection
title: Set Selection
description: Select objects by filter (IDs, names, layer, geometry type). Clears existing selection.

layer.description: Layer full path — selects all objects on layer

geometryType.description: Filter by type: point, pointset, curve, surface, brep, mesh, annotation, light, block

name: zoom_to_layer
title: Zoom To Layer
description: Zoom the active viewport to fit all objects on a layer (full path).

name: zoom_to_object
title: Zoom To Object
description: Zoom the active viewport to fit one or more objects by GUID.

name: _router_spawn_listener
description: Router-internal: create a new RhinoDoc and start an MCP listener bound to it. Returns { port }.

name: _router_close_listener
description: Router-internal: stop the MCP listener on the given port and close its associated doc without saving.

name: _router_quit_app
description: Router-internal: schedule a graceful Rhino exit via _Exit. Returns immediately; the actual quit fires shortly after on the UI thread.
